Конфлікт інтересів та шляхи його вирішен: Conflict of interest and how to resolve it
Основним із корупційних ризиків і той як: One of the main corruption risks, and one we often encounter in life, is a conflict of interest.
Конфлікт інтересів – це суперечність: A conflict of interest is a contradiction
між приватним інтересом особи та її служ: between a person’s private interest and their official or representative powers
Конфлікт інтересів поділяється на:: There are two types of conflict of interest:
Потенційний конфлікт інтересів це коли м: a potential conflict of interest — when a contradiction between a private interest and official duties is possible;
Реальний конфлікт інтересів це коли супе: an actual conflict of interest — when a contradiction between a private interest and official duties has already arisen.
Як показує практика потенційний конфлікт: Practice shows that a potential conflict of interest always turns into an actual one.
Основною складовою конфлікту інтересу є: The core element of a conflict of interest is a private interest, which can be either financial or non-financial.
Треба взяти до уваги, що приватний інтер: Please keep in mind that a private interest may affect, or does affect, the objectivity or impartiality of decisions made in the course of official duties.
ДНТ «Національна агенція розвитку терито: On 17 February 2023, the National Agency for Territorial Development of Ukraine approved the Procedure for preventing and resolving conflicts of interest, which sets out what an employee should do if a conflict of interest arises.
Працівник Товариства не пізніше наступно: No later than the day after a conflict of interest arises, the employee must notify the head of the enterprise in writing.
Після перевірки і підтвердження у праців: After verifying and confirming the conflict of interest, the head of the Company decides how to resolve it in accordance with the Procedure and the Law “On Prevention of Corruption”.
Особа є працівником державного некомерці: A person works at a state non-profit company and, in their free time, heads a charitable organisation — for example, a civic association or a charitable foundation (hereinafter, the NGO).
Зрозуміло, що на поточний момент Громадс: Today, such an NGO is most likely engaged in providing for and helping certain categories of citizens, which is also part of the Company’s statutory activities.
закладено потенційний конфлікт інтересів: contains a potential conflict of interest that may turn into an actual one.
Потенційний конфлікт переростає в реальн: A potential conflict becomes an actual one when the person starts using the NGO for personal gain in any way or links the Company’s activities with the NGO. This may include third parties (donors) funding the NGO with money intended for the Company’s activities, or misappropriating donor property intended for a state enterprise or a state programme. There can be many such situations, so we encourage you to seek advice in good time.
Це може бути як звернення в письмовій фо: You can request a written clarification from the NACP (in that case, please inform the director of your main place of work) or contact the Company’s Anti-Corruption Officer.
Треба розуміти що незнання законодавства: Please remember that ignorance of the law does not exempt anyone from criminal, administrative, civil or disciplinary liability.
Просимо звертатися за консультацією в бу: Feel free to ask for advice at any time.
: Будьте свідомими своїх власних інтерес: : Be aware of your own interests and make sure they do not overlap with duties or influences that could affect your decisions.
: Приділяйте увагу ситуаціям, де ваші ос: : Pay attention to situations where your personal interests may affect your ability to make objective decisions. For example, a financial interest in a particular business may affect your objectivity when assessing risks.
: Уникайте ситуацій, де ви зберігаєте ко: : Never keep a conflict of interest secret. Always inform your superiors or management about potential conflicts of interest that may affect your work or decisions.
: Заслуховуйтеся відповідних правил і по: : Familiarise yourself with your organisation’s rules and policies and follow them. These may include restrictions on financial investments, participation in certain transactions or accepting gifts from third parties.
: Якщо у вас є сумніви щодо можливого ко: : If you have doubts about a possible conflict of interest or are unsure how to identify or avoid it, do not hesitate to ask for help. Contact your management, the legal department or the Anti-Corruption Officer for advice and guidance.
: Не використовуйте своє становище або р: : Do not use your position or the organisation’s resources for personal gain. Remember your professional duties and your responsibility to the organisation, clients and stakeholders.
: Уникайте ситуацій, де ваша роль в одно: : Avoid situations where your role in one process overlaps with your role in another, as this may create a conflict of interest. For example, if you are responsible for procurement, do not decide on purchases from your personal business partners.
: Якщо ви виявите конфлікт інтересів або: : If you discover a conflict of interest or a situation that may create one, be honest and transparent. Inform the relevant parties and try to find a fair solution that resolves the conflict.
Пам’ятайте, конфлікт інтересів може пошк: Remember: a conflict of interest can damage your reputation, affect your relationships with others and even lead to legal problems. Always watch your actions and strive to act fairly and objectively.

Хто з юридичних осіб публічного права по: Who at legal entities of public law must submit declarations
Закон про відновлення декларування суттє: The law on the resumption of asset declarations significantly reduced the number of declarants at state and municipal enterprises, institutions and organisations that are legal entities of public law.
Згідно з роз’ясненням НАЗК, до декларант: According to the NACP’s clarification, the following officials of legal entities of public law are declarants:
голови та члени наглядової ради, ради ди: chairs and members of the supervisory board, board of directors, executive body, or termination commission (reorganisation or liquidation commission);
особа, яка здійснює повноваження одноосі: the person exercising the powers of a sole executive body and their deputies;
члени іншого органу управління (крім кон: members of other governing bodies (except advisory ones).
Тобто декларантами у ЮОПП залишилися лиш: In other words, only top officials remain declarants at such entities. Everyone else no longer has to submit declarations of any kind (including declarations upon dismissal and annual declarations for 2021, 2022 and 2023), in particular:
інші працівники ЮОПП, які мають повноваж: other employees with organisational, administrative or economic powers;
Якщо ж працівник ЮОПП є декларантом за і: However, if an employee is a declarant by virtue of another position or status defined in Article 3 of the Law (for example, a member of a local council), they must submit all declarations required by the Law.
Декларації, які під час дії воєнного ста: Declarations voluntarily submitted during martial law by persons who have no longer been declarants since 12 October 2023 are kept in the Register of Declarations for five years.
Проте остання подана такою особою деклар: However, the last declaration submitted by such a person will be kept indefinitely. Current legislation does not provide for deleting such declarations before the five-year period expires.

Коли відбувається фінансування виплат до: When are living allowances for internally displaced persons funded?

Які документи необхідні подати для призн: What documents are required to receive or extend payments?
Потрібно подати паспорт, ідентифікаційни: You need to submit your passport, taxpayer identification number and a medical and social expert commission certificate (for persons with disabilities). You may also need a certificate of income, a certificate from your employer or the employment centre, a certificate of family composition, or a certificate from your children’s school or kindergarten stating that there are no places or that studies are held online or remotely (fully or partially), etc.
На який термін призначаються виплати?: For how long are payments granted?
З 1 листопада 2023 року допомога признач: Since 1 November 2023, the allowance is granted for six months, with the possibility of extending it for another six months for socially vulnerable families (automatically or upon application).
Куди звернутися якщо не отримую виплати: Where should I go if I do not receive payments or receive only part of them?
Для вирішення питання щодо призначення/с: For questions about granting, cancelling, accruing or delayed IDP payments, contact the social protection department of the district where you are registered as an IDP: these departments keep IDP registers and accrue this type of assistance.
Мій чоловік – працівник правоохоронних о: My husband works in law enforcement (a serviceman or an employee of the National Guard, the SBU, the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the State Special Communications Service or other military formations established by law). Will his income be taken into account when calculating the family’s (household’s) average monthly total income?
До середньомісячного сукупного доходу ос: For persons who take (took) direct part in measures to ensure national security and defence and to repel and deter the armed aggression of the Russian Federation, the average monthly total income does not include the pay and other payments and social assistance provided by law to law enforcement officers (servicemen, employees of the National Guard, the SBU, the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the State Special Communications Service and other military formations established by law) received during such participation.
Передбачено, що виплата продовжується на: The payment is extended for a second six-month period automatically for:
дітям-сиротам та дітям, позбавленим бать: orphans and children deprived of parental care, and persons from among them under 23, including those in family-type children’s homes and foster families, as well as family-type home parents, foster parents and guardians (custodians);
отримувачам пенсії, розмір якої не перев: pensioners whose pension does not exceed four times the subsistence minimum for persons unable to work as of 1 January of the year in which the decision on assistance is made;
особам з інвалідністю I чи II групи, дит: persons with group I or II disabilities, children with disabilities under 18 and seriously ill children.

Питання-відповіді щодо осіб безвісти зни: Questions and answers about persons missing under special circumstances or held in captivity
Інформація, щодо військових та цивільних: Information about missing military and civilians is entered and kept:
в Єдиному реєстрі осіб, зниклих безвісти: in the Unified Register of Persons Missing under Special Circumstances, maintained by the Department for Persons Missing under Special Circumstances (Secretariat of the Commissioner for Persons Missing under Special Circumstances) of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Ukraine;
в реєстрі «Оборонців» НІБ (ДП «Українськ: in the National Information Bureau’s “Defenders” register (SE “Ukrainian National Centre for Peacebuilding”), the information from which is passed to the Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War;
в реєстрі МКЧХ (Міжнародний Комітет Черв: in the register of the ICRC (International Committee of the Red Cross);
в реєстрі Координаційного штабу з питань: in the register of the Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War.
Встановлення факту перебування в полоні?: How is the fact of captivity established?
Статус перебування в полоні з будь якого: The captivity status in any of the above registers may change after confirmation by the aggressor state through the ICRC.
Також для встановлення факту перебування: To establish the fact of captivity, a person released from captivity or the relatives (or an authorised representative) of a prisoner of war must fill in an application in the prescribed form.
До заяви також потрібно додати наступні: The following documents must be attached to the application:
Документи, що підтверджують громадянство: documents confirming the Ukrainian citizenship of both the person deprived of liberty and the applicant;
Документи, що підтверджують спорідненіст: documents confirming the family relationship between the person deprived of liberty and the applicant;
Довідка про те, що військовослужбовець п: a certificate stating that the serviceman or servicewoman was or is held in places of deprivation of liberty as a result of russia’s armed aggression against Ukraine, indicating the period of detention, in accordance with Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 55 of 20.01.2023 (for military personnel);
Документи та/або відомості, що підтвердж: documents and/or information confirming the fact and circumstances of deprivation of liberty (for civilians):
витяг з Єдиного державного реєстру досуд: an extract from the Unified Register of Pre-trial Investigations (if criminal proceedings concerning the person have been opened);
повідомлення органів сил безпеки та сил: notifications from the security and defence forces concerning the person;
документи та/або відомості, що підтвердж: documents and/or information confirming the fact and circumstances of deprivation of liberty (civilians are not limited in the evidence they may provide, i.e. they can submit any documents they consider necessary).
Витяг з Єдиного реєстру досудових розслі: an extract from the Unified Register of Pre-trial Investigations (if available);
Повідомлення органів сил безпеки та сил: notifications from the security and defence forces concerning the person (if available).

Як відбувається пошук безвісті зниклих?: How are missing persons searched for?
Після відкриття кримінального провадженн: After criminal proceedings are opened (data entered in the Unified Register of Pre-trial Investigations) on the disappearance of a civilian or serviceman, the police begin investigative actions, search measures and forensic examinations;
Також пошукові заходи можуть проводитись: search operations may also be carried out by mobile groups of the Armed Forces of Ukraine in frontline areas;
На тимчасово окупованій території Україн: in the temporarily occupied territory of Ukraine and in the territory of the RF, the ICRC carries out search activities in the aggressor state at the request of the victim (relatives or an authorised representative of the missing person, prisoner of war or civilian).
Чому змінюється статус з полоненого на п: Why does the status change from “prisoner” to “search for a person”?
Якщо статус полоненого підтверджено відп: If prisoner status was confirmed on the basis of open-source information, then after portrait and other examinations by law enforcement agencies, the status in the Coordination Headquarters register may be changed to “search for the person”.
Яку допомогу в пошуку безвісти зниклих м: How can we, as relatives, help the authorities speed up the search for missing persons?
Потерпілі (рідні) мають право подавати с: victims (relatives) have the right to submit to the investigator any evidence found during the search for the missing person;
Клопотати про призначення портретної чи: request a portrait or other forensic examination, etc.;
Поговорити з побратимами, які служать у: talk to fellow soldiers who serve in the same unit or took part in the battles during which the defender went missing;
Переглядати фото, відео та дописи на рос: review photos, videos and posts on russian propaganda resources that publish information about Ukrainians who were captured or killed;
Зустрітися з колишніми військовополонени: meet former prisoners of war who have returned from captivity, talk to them and show them photos or videos of the person being sought;
Бути на зв’язку та відстежувати в месенд: stay in touch and check in messengers whether the person’s number has come online.
